description: After a .xaml or .cs edit, ask the DevServer (uno-devserver app hot-reload-status) whether the running Uno app applied it through Hot Reload and tell the agent the result. The App MCP that Uno.Sdk 6.7 pins (1.3 and 1.4) has no status tool, so on this line the hook reminds the agent that Hot Reload applies the edit and that a check by selector, or uno_app_start again, confirms it.
